title: My pipes
intro: Every pipe has a story. Keep its details, memories and photographs.
emptyText: Add your first pipe to start your catalogue.
footnote: Functional prototype V1 · Data is stored only in this browser. Cloud storage is not available yet: do not use this version as your only archive for important data. You can export and import a JSON backup.
choosePhoto: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (max 3 MB)
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
importConfirm: Import {{count}} pipes? Your current collection will be replaced.
recoveryConfirm: The current data cannot be read. Download the original data first to preserve it. Replace it with this backup?
photoInvalid: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP file up to 3 MB.
storageRead: Unable to read stored data. The original data has not been changed. Download it for recovery or import a valid backup.
storageWrite: Unable to save. Browser storage may be full: export your data and try smaller photos.
importError: Import failed: invalid format or data (maximum 20 MB, no duplicate IDs).
rawError: Unable to access the original browser data.
soonText: This module will be available in a future milestone.

auth.localNotice: The catalogue displays only the current account’s cloud pipes. Local data is never imported or deleted automatically. Legacy photos are retained pending Phase B.
auth.unavailable: Account access is not configured. Local data is preserved; the catalogue requires authentication.
auth.badConfig: Account configuration is invalid. Contact the site administrator. Local data is preserved.
auth.confirmed: Email confirmed. You are signed in.
auth.checkEmail: Check your inbox for the confirmation link. If your address is already registered, try signing in or recovering your password. Open the link in the same browser and on the same site where you registered.
auth.resetSent: If the address is registered, you will receive a recovery email. Open the link in the same browser and on the same site where you requested it.
auth.sessionEnded: You are signed out. Sign in again to access your account.
auth.passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. Do not reuse passwords from other sites.

errors.unconfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in. Check your inbox and spam folder.
errors.password: Use a password of at least 12 characters that meets the security requirements.
errors.samePassword: Choose a different password from the current one.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.callback: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Use the same browser and site where you requested it. Request a new recovery email or try signing in after confirmation.
errors.generic: Unable to complete the operation. Check your connection and try again. If you already have an account, try signing in or recovering your password.
errors.session: Unable to restore access. Check your connection and retry.
errors.profile: You are signed in, but your profile could not be prepared. Retry; your local data has not changed.

cloud.intro: This account’s records are saved in the cloud.
cloud.photoPending: Legacy photographs in importable records: {{count}}. They will be retained in the original record data; no Storage upload is performed.
cloud.migrationHelp: Download a backup first. Records are added without replacing different cloud records with the same ID. Browser data is never deleted. Repeating the procedure does not duplicate IDs.
cloud.confirmImport: Transfer {{count}} records to account {{email}}? Existing IDs will not be overwritten. Photos stay in the original record data without Storage upload. Local data will not be deleted.
cloud.result: Records verified in cloud: {{verified}}. Excluded: {{rejected}}. Conflicts or errors: {{failed}}. Not attempted: {{unattempted}}.
cloud.photosNotUploaded: Photograph migration is NOT complete. Photos in verified records remain in the original record data; excluded or failed photos remain in the source. Keep the backup. Storage uploads will be available in Phase B.
cloud.photoReadOnly: Legacy photos are retained unchanged. Adding, replacing and uploading photographs will be available in Phase B.
cloud.footnote: Cloud catalogue for the current account. Export a JSON backup regularly. Original local data stays in the browser; legacy photographs have not been transferred to Storage yet.
cloud.signInRequired: Sign in from Account to view your pipes. Existing local data is preserved and is not displayed without authentication.
cloud.profileRequired: Complete profile preparation in Account before using the catalogue.

errors.network: Cloud operation not verified. Check your connection and reload before retrying: a write may already have reached the server.
errors.session: Your session is unavailable or expired. Sign in again.
errors.response: Invalid cloud response. No data from another account is displayed.
errors.conflict: The record was changed or removed, or the ID already exists. Reload from cloud before retrying.
errors.references: This record is referenced by other records and cannot be deleted.
errors.importConflict: The ID exists with different data or verification does not match. The cloud record was not overwritten; keep the backup for review.
errors.source: The file is not a readable version 1 backup (maximum 20 MB per file, 10,000 records). Download the originals if available.
errors.local: Unable to read the local catalogue. No data was deleted.

reasons.json: The record contains values that cannot be represented in the database.
reasons.price: Negative prices are not supported in cloud. Correct a copy of the backup before importing.
reasons.date: Invalid purchase date. Correct a copy of the backup before importing.
reasons.duplicate: Repeated source ID: all occurrences are excluded to avoid ambiguity.
